hypothesis: Packaging the multi-fold-validated E019 Residual CNO (frozen real E005 backbone + 10.8k residual adapter) with persist-first-4, singleton micro-batching, and calibrated uncertainty will pass every official local submission gate, maintain exact batch invariance, execute within 5 minutes, and provide a direct model-quality upgrade over E013 on Codabench.
single_change_from_e013: replace the base CNO with ResidualCNO (trained 3D Conv residual adapter on top of frozen real E005 CNO)

public_contract_windows.purpose: contract testing only; not model selection evidence

local_gpu_whole_run_proxy.construction: cycle the two public contract windows; no additional field data
local_gpu_whole_run_proxy.interpretation: supplementary RTX 5050/Torch 2.7.1 evidence for the A800/Torch 2.2.2 limit

controls: k=4 is frozen from E012/E013 and is not retuned
The E005 backbone weights, normalizer, E006 interval, and singleton batching remain unchanged
Residual adapter has 10,835 trainable parameters and was trained on Fold A (E019) with E005 relative loss
Multi-fold validation on Fold B (E020) confirmed split robustness
Bounds are computed on the hybrid persist-first-4 prediction
Codabench scores are not used for parameter selection
decision_rule: Promote and retain the archive only if every package, official-container, bounds, determinism, scorer, and runtime gate passes.
promotion: submission candidate if all local gates pass; E013 remains the scored Codabench baseline until a new official result is recorded
limitations: Clean quality evidence is the E019 Fold A row (94.619 Rel-L2, 72.255 TKE, 95.302 MVPE, 38.645 SPS) and E020 Fold B row (94.542 Rel-L2, 72.650 TKE, 95.203 MVPE, 37.202 SPS).
Local RTX 5050/Torch 2.7.1 timing is not the official A800/Torch 2.2.2 measurement.
